annotation.speech2: The same oval through A and B, but now both halves run from A to B. The upper half C 1 is drawn in blue and the lower half, relabeled minus C 2 and drawn in green, has its arrow reversed so that it also runs from A to B. Since both curves connect A to B, path independence makes the two line integrals equal.
The piece C 1, still running from A to B along the top.
The reversed piece minus C 2, drawn in green, now running from A to B along the bottom. C 1 and minus C 2 both connect A to B.
